product_overview: Odi.Pet is a pet care platform for pet owners to log in, manage pet profiles, and monitor their pets’ health information. Users can view dashboards with active pets and upcoming care schedules, and add new pets to their account.
core_goals: Log in to access the pet owner experience
View an overview of active pets and upcoming health or routine events
Register new pets with profile and basic health details
Review and manage pet profile and health record information

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows pet owners to sign in with their email and password to access their account.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the owner dashboard

features.name: Pet Owner Dashboard
features.description: Shows an overview of the owner’s pets, active pet details, upcoming health and routine events, and quick actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/dashboard -> View the pet overview slider -> Switch the active pet -> Review the active pet’s weight, age, and health status -> Review upcoming vaccines, parasite checks, and checkups -> Use a quick action shortcut

features.name: Add Pet
features.description: Lets pet owners register a new pet with profile details and initial health information.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/pets/add -> Enter the pet name -> Select the species and breed -> Enter the birth date -> Enter the gender -> Enter the initial weight -> Submit the pet registration form -> See the newly added pet reflected in the account

features.name: Pet Management and Details
features.description: Provides access to individual pet profiles and health record information for viewing and editing.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/pets -> Select a pet from the list -> Open the pet detail page -> View the pet profile and health record information
Navigate to /owner/pets -> Select a pet from the list -> Open the pet detail page -> Update profile information -> Save the changes -> See the updated pet details
